name: Egyptians For Investment & Urban Development
source: Yahoo Finance chart API (OHLC split-adjusted, not dividend-adjusted)
basis_note: Split-adjusted: past bars are adjusted for splits only, NOT for dividends. This is TradingView's default chart basis (its 'Adjust data for dividends' option is off by default).
stagnant_note: Stagnant: the stored series carries no session with a price range (every bar is flat), so the counter has not printed a two-sided session in the archive. Flat bars with v=0 are untraded/carried sessions, not trades.
